description: This file defines a custom serializer class 'DateTimeCodec' for serializing and deserializing the DateTime structure in Orleans.Serialization framework. It implements the IFieldCodec interface with methods to read and write DateTime values efficiently using binary representation.

classes.name: DateTimeCodec
classes.description: Serializer for DateTime, handling binary serialization/deserialization

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a DateTime value to the buffer with field header, for serialization

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a DateTime value from the buffer, for deserialization
